AI Product Manager
Product Development Position Overview
We are looking for a dynamic AI Product Manager to lead the development and strategic implementation of AI-driven solutions within the US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) ecosystem. This role will involve working closely with stakeholders to define and deliver AI products that solve business challenges and improve operational efficiency across Coding, Charge Entry, EDI, AR, Denials, Payments, and Operational Insights. The ideal candidate will have expertise in AI/ML, Healthcare RCM processes, and a strong ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including engineering, data science, and business teams. Lab space expertise is a valuable addition to enhance the product s focus on data-driven clinical and operational workflows.
Job Roles Responsibilities
AI Strategy Product Vision:
  • Define and execute the AI product roadmap for Healthcare RCM, incorporating solutions in predictive analytics, intelligent automation, NLP, LLM-driven features, and AI-powered data agents.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and communicate a clear AI product vision that aligns with business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities for AI and ML applications in Billing, Claims Management, and Revenue Cycle Operations to optimize financial and operational processes in Healthcare RCM.
AI/ML Solution Design Integration :
  • Design and manage end-to-end AI/ML workflows from data ingestion to model training, inference, and integration into operational workflows.
  • Lead the development of machine learning models, focusing on denial prediction, AR prioritization, coding assistance, and automation of RCM tasks.
  • Define prompt engineering guidelines, model behaviors, evaluation metrics, and improvement loops in collaboration with data scientists and AI teams.
  • Work with product engineering teams to integrate AI/ML models into existing back-end systems, APIs, and user interfaces (UI).
Requirement Gathering Prioritization :
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, including business analysts, data teams, and clients, to gather and prioritize AI use cases across all RCM functions.
  • Conduct feasibility analysis of machine learning, NLP, and AI automation applications in healthcare operations, assessing the ROI and business impact of AI solutions.
  • Maintain and manage a clear backlog of AI features with defined business and technical priorities.
Collaboration Execution:
  • Lead cross-functional teams (data science, engineering, product, client success, and business) to ensure successful AI product development and implementation.
  • Facilitate the integration of AI products into lab space environments, helping improve data collection, insights, and workflow optimization in clinical and operational settings.
  • Oversee agile development cycles, ensuring sprint planning, development, and delivery align with the AI product roadmap and timelines.
Analytics Data Responsibilities :
  • Work closely with data engineers to integrate RCM datasets, PMS/EHR systems, and EDI structures into AI-powered features.
  • Ensure data is prepared, cleaned, and analyzed to support model training, accuracy testing, and identifying actionable insights for AI-driven features.
  • Validate model outputs, monitor accuracy, and detect model drift to ensure models provide consistent, high-quality predictions and business value.
AI Governance Compliance :
  • Ensure AI-driven products adhere to HIPAA, PHI, compliance, data privacy, and safety standards.
  • Define responsible AI guidelines, guardrails, fallback behaviors, and audit logs to ensure the AI models are ethical, explainable, and non-biased.
  • Establish ongoing model monitoring systems to detect anomalies, track usage, and manage real-time feedback loops from healthcare operations and clients.
Lab Space Expertise (Advantageous) :
  • Collaborate with clinical teams and researchers in lab spaces to integrate AI-powered solutions into real-time clinical and operational workflows.
  • Work with healthcare practitioners, research labs, and clinical trial environments to understand how AI tools can optimize lab operations, manage data, and improve patient care delivery through AI/ML technologies.
  • Provide guidance on the integration of AI solutions in biological and clinical datasets for enhanced medical insights.
Client Interaction Adoption :
  • Conduct product demos, training, and enablement sessions for internal teams, healthcare clients, and end-users to drive adoption and maximize product usage.
  • Collect feedback on AI-driven capabilities, and use this feedback to continuously refine AI products and develop a roadmap for future enhancements.
  • Track product performance, usage statistics, client satisfaction, and efficiency gains to ensure AI product success.
Candidate Requirements
  • Bachelor s/Master s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in product management or AI/ML development, including at least 3 years focusing on AI-driven products for Healthcare RCM or US Healthcare.
  • Proven experience in leading AI-powered product development, with a focus on predictive analytics, natural language processing (NLP), automation, and AI in healthcare.
  • Strong understanding of Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) processes, including coding, charge entry, EDI, AR, denials, and payment management.
  • Experience in AI/ML platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, OpenAI), as well as cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
  • Hands-on experience in working with PMS/EHR systems and healthcare data standards like HL7, FHIR, and EDI formats.
  • Familiarity with clinical lab systems, biomedical data, and how AI can be applied to improve lab space operations (an advantage).
  • Experience in AI product lifecycle management, from ideation to deployment and continuous improvement.
  • Strong skills in agile development, managing sprints, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of AI model governance, ethical AI development, and data privacy/compliance requirements in healthcare.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with AI integration in clinical workflows or biomedical research.
  • Familiarity with RPA (Robotic Process Automation) technologies and their integration with AI models to streamline healthcare processes.
  • Experience working in multi-team collaboration and managing global product teams.
  • Experience with AI-based solutions for clinical trial management, patient monitoring systems, and personalized healthcare delivery.
  • Certifications in Healthcare IT, RCM, or AI product management are a plus.
Soft Skills:
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to align AI solutions with business goals and customer needs.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work across diverse teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving AI/ML and healthcare ecosystem.

jobDescription:
We are currently seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure to join the AI Platform team that powers seamless insights and interaction through natural language and data intelligence across our AI products.
As a Staff Software Engineer, you ll architect, build, and operate the backend and platform systems that power AI Platform. You ll work across service design, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, event-driven processing, observability, CI/CD, and production reliability, helping shape the technical direction of a platform that supports scalable, client-facing AI experiences.
This role requires a strong software engineering foundation combined with deep infrastructure and systems thinking. We are looking for an engineer who can write high-quality production code, make sound architectural tradeoffs, and own platform capabilities end-to-end not someone focused only on scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling in isolation.
You will collaborate closely with frontend, product, and AI/ML engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable systems that align with Addepar s standards of performance, resilience, and trust.
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
What You ll Do
  • Design, build, and operate backend services and infrastructure that power AI Platform products.
  • Write high-quality production code for platform and service layers, with strong emphasis on maintainability, reliability, and performance.
  • Architect and evolve distributed systems that support AI Platform capabilities such as real-time interactions, asynchronous processing, and secure data workflows.
  • Build and extend cloud-native infrastructure across core services, networking, storage, identity, and observability layers.
  • Design and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, environment management, and drift-safe workflows.
  • Build and operate Kubernetes/EKS-based services, including deployment strategies, health checks, scaling configuration, and containerization workflows.
  • Design and improve CI/CD pipelines, release workflows, and engineering productivity systems.
  • Build and maintain asynchronous and event-driven systems using queues, RPC/service communication, and resilient failure-handling patterns.
  • Design and evolve relational and NoSQL data models, including schema design, migrations, replication, and access patterns.
  • Build and maintain observability across metrics, logs, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.
  • Apply secure-by-default engineering practices across IAM, secrets, encryption, network isolation, and production operations.
  • Mentor engineers through code review, design review, incident reviews, and technical guidance.
  • Drive technical decisions that improve platform reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and long-term system health.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • At least 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in backend, infrastructure OR platform oriented work.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one production backend language such as Python, Go, OR Java and the ability to work effectively across a polyglot environment.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, debugging, code quality, testing, and operational ownership.
  • Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code workflows such as Terraform or equivalent tools.
  • Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, and modern deployment practices.
  • Experience designing or extending CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservice communication, message queues, asynchronous processing, and failure handling.
  • Experience with both relational and NoSQL database design in production systems.
  • Strong observability and production-debugging skills.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
  • Ability to operate as a software engineer first: we are not looking for someone who is only strong in scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling without corresponding depth in production software engineering.
Bonus
  • Experience with AI/ML platform tooling such as Databricks, Spark, MLflow, or model-serving systems.
  • Experience with real-time streaming or WebSocket-based systems at scale.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, data residency, or failover design.
  • Experience in fintech or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience optimizing platform cost, performance, and reliability tradeoffs at scale.

jobDescription:
Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Back Office Quality Assurance Consultant (IC4) to lead quality assurance across complex Back Office platforms, integrations, and business-critical operations.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who demonstrates strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in fast-paced, high-impact environments.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring delivery quality, production stability, and operational excellence, while proactively identifying risks, driving automation, and influencing stakeholders across multiple systems and business domains.

This role is ideal for a QA professional who thrives on deep technical and strategic contribution, values continuous improvement, and has a strong interest in AI-driven QA and modern testing practices.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end QA activities across complex Back Office systems, workflows, integrations, and enterprise business processes.

  • Develop and execute effective test strategies, test plans, and validation approaches aligned with business and technical objectives.

  • Ensure release readiness, production stability, and high-quality delivery outcomes across multiple initiatives.

  • Manage competing priorities between BAU support and project deliverables while maintaining QA standards.

  • Apply risk-based testing methodologies to prioritize testing efforts effectively.

  • Identify quality risks, dependencies, gaps, and release concerns early, and provide actionable mitigation plans.

  • Take initiative during critical delivery situations such as unclear requirements, testing blockers, integration issues, or release instability.

  • Partner closely with business stakeholders to align on quality expectations and release readiness.

  • Act as a trusted QA advisor, communicating risks, progress, and recommendations clearly.

  • Influence decisions through expertise, data-driven insights, and effective communication.

  • Demonstrate strong individual contributor leadership through accountability, professionalism, and ownership.

  • Mentor and support QA engineers through coaching, reviews, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, operational excellence, and quality-first thinking.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-powered QA solutions and intelligent automation practices across testing processes.

  • Champion automation-first and AI-assisted testing approaches to improve efficiency, scalability, and coverage.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and optimize QA processes through automation and innovation.

  • Contribute to the enhancement of QA frameworks, standards, tools, and delivery practices.

  • Collaborate with engineering and technology teams to integrate automation and AI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and QA workflows.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, automation platforms, and AI-driven testing tools to improve quality engineering practices.

What you will bring

  • 8+ years extensive Quality Assurance experience.

  • Strong practical knowledge of risk-based testing methodologies.

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

jobDescription:
About the Team
The Workflows Module is the key component of HighLevel s automation engine, enabling agencies and businesses to create powerful, automated workflows that enhance efficiency, save time, and improve outcomes. By integrating with multiple product areas within the HighLevel platform, the Workflows Module empowers users to streamline processes, nurture leads, and manage tasks seamlessly.
As part of the team, you ll work on improving existing capabilities within workflows, conceptualizing new workflow features, and delivering solutions that drive adoption, activation, and business growth. The team is committed to optimizing user experience, increasing efficiency, and helping customers get the most value out of HighLevel.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Workflows Team. This role is perfect for a self-driven individual who is passionate about automation and SaaS products. As a SPM, you will help build impactful features and refine existing capabilities in the Workflows Module, making it easier for users to automate complex business processes.
You will work closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to understand user pain points, develop innovative solutions, and ensure seamless execution. You will play a critical role in driving product success by leveraging data, user insights, and collaborative teamwork.
Your Responsibilities
You will own key parts of the Workflows product experience across activation, builder usability, execution reliability, and long-term engagement. This includes identifying high-impact opportunities across the workflow funnel, simplifying complex automation journeys, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ship scalable improvements that help customers automate more of their business operations.
  • Workflow Funnel Optimization: Identify and close gaps from workflow creation to execution to improve activation and adoption rates across accounts.
  • Time to Value Acceleration: Drive initiatives that make it faster and easier for users to launch their first meaningful automation.
  • Retention Engagement: Lead efforts to make workflows a sticky, high-usage product that users return to regularly.
  • Builder Simplicity Usability: Champion ease-of-use by simplifying complex concepts, refining the UI, and reducing friction in critical paths.
  • Template Entry Point Expansion:Launch iterative improvements to templates, hotlinks and suggested workflows to bridge intent and execution.
  • Support Insight to Product Fixes: Analyze support tickets and user feedback to identify and resolve common sources of confusion or setup failure.
  • Optimizing existing workflows, ensuring they are intuitive, scalable and aligned with customer needs.
  • Manage New Features: Managing workflow feature requests, tracking, prioritizing and ensuring timely execution of essential updates.
  • Cross Team Collaboration: Collaborating with other product teams (CRM, Reporting, Payments, AI, and Integrations) to ensure seamless cross-functional workflow improvements.
  • Tracking Metrics: Tracking performance metrics to identify usability bottlenecks, activation adoption trends, and areas for optimization.
  • Staying updated on industry trends in automation, integrations, and no-code/low-code platforms to drive innovation within workflows.
Your Core Skills
  • Passionate about building intuitive and scalable workflow automation solutions.
  • Ability to deeply understand user problems, spot friction in product flows, and make thoughtful trade-offs between power and simplicity.
  • Comfort with digging into usage data, funnels, and support patterns to find actionable insights.
  • Understanding of product development lifecycle and experience working on SaaS products.
  • Strong analytical mindset to interpret user behavior, identify pain points, and optimize workflow functionalities.
  • Leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives forward.
  • Understanding of automation tools and workflow best practices to enhance user experience.
  • Ability to deconstruct complex software experiences and highlight good UX from bad UX.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation platforms is a plus.
  • A problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.
Experience
  • 8+ years of Product Management experience ideally in SaaS or automation platforms
  • Proven track record of shipping complex, user-facing features in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven experience owning large-scale, customer-facing product platforms
  • Experience working on workflow automation tools or CRM platforms is a plus

Role: GenAI Lead Engineer

Job Overview:

We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership:
  • Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

  • Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.

  • Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
  • Integration and Deployment:
  • API Development: Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
  • Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
  • Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.
  • Data Strategy and Preparation:
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
  • Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.
  • Innovation and Research:
  • Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
  • Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration:
  • Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
  • Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

Key Requirements

  • Technical Skills:
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
  • Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI s ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
  • Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
  • Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
  • Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
  • Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
  • Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
  • Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
  • Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
  • 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
  • Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
  • Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
  • Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
  • Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).
